# Gary Lucy

> Official site of Gary Lucy, a British screen and stage actor with nearly
> three decades of professional credits.

Gary Lucy is a British actor known for major returning roles in Hollyoaks
(Luke Morgan), Footballers' Wives (Kyle Pascoe), The Bill (Will Fletcher)
and EastEnders (Danny Pennant). His most recent screen role is Mike Curtis
in series 4 of Acorn TV's The Chelsea Detective, alongside Channel 5's The
Good Ship Murder as Jason Agnew. He won Best Newcomer at the 2000 British
Soap Awards and led the UK touring stage production of The Full Monty. He
is also Founder and Commercial Lead of SOS Global AI, a UK company
building sector-specific AI systems for recruitment and television
development (https://sosglobalai.com).

## Key facts
- Full name: Gary Edward Lucy
- Born: 27 November 1981, Chigwell, Essex, England
- Years active: 1996–present
- Official site: https://garylucy.co.uk/
- Other venture: https://sosglobalai.com (Founder and Commercial Lead)
